title: Dean's List Academic Excellence
description: Recognized for outstanding academic performance and placed on the Dean's List for exceptional CGPA during the academic year.

title: GIS Mapping Competition — 1st Place
description: Won first place in the departmental GIS mapping competition for flood susceptibility mapping using multi-criteria spatial analysis. Competed against 15 teams.

title: Research Grant — Undergraduate Research Award
description: Received undergraduate research funding for the flood risk assessment project studying coastal vulnerability in southwest Bangladesh.

title: National Urban Planning Conference Participant
description: Participated in the National Urban Planning Conference, presenting research on GIS applications in flood risk management and urban resilience.

title: NASA ARSET Training Completion
description: Successfully completed NASA's Applied Remote Sensing Training on flood inundation mapping using SAR data, an internationally recognized professional development program.

title: Best Thesis Presentation Award
description: Recognized for the best thesis presentation in the department for research work on spatial analysis and flood risk assessment.
